parsedVerdict.reasoning: TaskController sits in the infrastructure layer and only does transport and adapter work. It registers Express routes, coerces request bodies, route parameters and query strings into typed inputs, and passes every operation to TaskManagementService. It also maps results to HTTP status codes and hands errors to Express. The helpers text() and parameter() check input shape (is it a string, is it a single value). That is transport validation, not a business rule. The controller turns status strings into values with the domain's asTaskStatus instead of defining the valid statuses itself. Operations like markTaskDone, task creation and filtering are left to the application service. No business rule, persistence or orchestration logic sits in this file.
